one_sentence_story: A source artifact sends one luminous thread through a transparent context capsule, where a cusp opens an auditable seam and a paper claim closes only after the hexagonal fibre leaves a world trace.

beats.title: source enters
beats.causal_move: A single paper sheet descends onto a dark hexagonal world tile and emits one amber evidence thread.
beats.visual_action: Keep the sheet as the persistent source object; animate only its seal opening and the first thread pulse.
beats.receipt_object: A small amber source marker remains attached to the thread origin.

beats.title: special points separate
beats.causal_move: The thread crosses three clean waypoints labelled 3, 4, and infinity, separating the special points without adding interface chrome.
beats.visual_action: Place three luminous nodes on the same path; the torus ring repeats once at each node and keeps its orientation.
beats.receipt_object: Each node receives one visible tick on the thread, not a dashboard panel.

beats.title: cusp opens seam
beats.causal_move: At the cusp, the torus fibre twists once and opens one seam while the transparent Context Capsule passes over it.
beats.visual_action: Rotate the fibre by a fixed quarter-turn, split one highlighted arc, then freeze the capsule around the split; do not dissolve the source.
beats.receipt_object: The open seam is the only new object; its two endpoints carry matching cyan dots.

beats.title: fibre becomes hexagon
beats.causal_move: The opened fibre resolves into a six-sided dP6 polygon and its three opposite side pairs meet as one visible stitch.
beats.visual_action: Transform the torus cross-section into a regular six-sided outline, then animate side pairs 1-4, 2-5, and 3-6 meeting in sequence.
beats.receipt_object: Three stitch flashes remain as a compact world trace beside the polygon.

beats.title: claim closes with receipt
beats.causal_move: Only after all three stitches close, the capsule reveals a restrained paper claim and routes the thread into a final receipt node.
beats.visual_action: Draw the final boundary around the hexagon, then reveal the claim label and a world-trace glyph made of real short text, never pseudo-text.
beats.on_screen_text:
PAPER CLAIM: TOTAL SPACE ~ S6
RECEIPT: SOURCE -> CUSP -> dP6 -> CLOSURE
beats.receipt_object: A white receipt strip is stamped CLOSED only at the end; the claim remains explicitly attributed to the paper.

persistent_objects.name: source_sheet
persistent_objects.continuity_rule: Never remove it; amber thread origin stays visible in every beat.

persistent_objects.name: evidence_thread
persistent_objects.continuity_rule: One path only; it changes colour from amber to cyan at the capsule boundary.

persistent_objects.name: context_capsule
persistent_objects.continuity_rule: Appears at B3 and remains around the seam, fibre, and final claim.

persistent_objects.name: torus_family
persistent_objects.continuity_rule: Same ring geometry at the three special points; only the cusp instance twists.

persistent_objects.name: receipt_strip
persistent_objects.continuity_rule: Blank until B5, then receives the four-step trace and CLOSED stamp.

caption_script: At the cusp, monodromy opens one seam.
The fibre becomes a hexagonal dP6 surface; opposite sides stitch in pairs.
Paper claim: after closure, the total space is S6. The receipt shows the path.

manim_plan.determinism: Set a fixed seed, fixed camera, fixed colours, fixed z-order, and fixed frame rate; all geometry is constructed from named points and line segments.
scene_order: Create source_sheet, three waypoint nodes, torus rings, context_capsule, and receipt_strip before animation.
Use LaggedStart only for the single evidence_thread pulse; use Transform for torus-to-hexagon.
Use explicit ValueTrackers for cusp rotation and seam gap; no random noise or generated text.
Write captions from a fixed list of five strings with a monospace font and safe line lengths.
Export a final frame and a receipt JSON containing source pointer, seed, render command, and output hash.
manim_plan.negative_space_rule: No panels, buttons, gauges, fake logs, or unreadable pseudo-text; only source, thread, capsule, fibre, claim, and receipt remain.

falsifier.rule: Reject this candidate if the render does not preserve the three special points, cusp monodromy, the hexagon/dP6 fibre, and the final S6 closure.
falsifier.operational_test: Frame-by-frame inspection must find 3, 4, infinity, one opened cusp seam, six countable sides, three opposite-side stitches, and the final claim plus receipt.

receipts.command: jq -r '.deliverable.required_fields | length' w1-evidence-thread-fleet-prompt.v1.json; jq -r '.deliverable.beats' w1-evidence-thread-fleet-prompt.v1.json; jq -r '.fake_evidence' w1-evidence-thread-fleet-prompt.v1.json; jq -r '.deliverable.path_pattern' w1-evidence-thread-fleet-prompt.v1.json; jq -r '.constraints | length' w1-evidence-thread-fleet-prompt.v1.json
jq -r '.iterations | length' W1-MANIFEST.json; jq -r '.range' W1-MANIFEST.json; jq -r '.fake_evidence' W1-MANIFEST.json
jq -r '.schema' s6-modular-family-film.v1.json; jq -r '.source_facts | length' s6-modular-family-film.v1.json; jq -r '.falsifier' s6-modular-family-film.v1.json
receipts.output: herakles.math-film-source.v1; 7; If the rendered transition does not preserve the three special points, cusp monodromy, hexagon/dP6 fibre and S6 closure, reject the film.
